title: project-map: how it works
subtitle: scan a repo → draft map → tidy (by hand or with an agent) → interactive page → optional live board

nodes.title: Your repository
nodes.detail: Any git repository. Nothing is uploaded; everything runs locally.

nodes.title: Agent skills & timers
nodes.detail: Agent skills that mention the project, and scheduled jobs that run it.

nodes.title: Agent session logs
nodes.detail: Read by the live board to see which agent is working and on what.

nodes.title: discover.py
nodes.detail: Standard library only. Finds scripts, commands, CI, timers, app modules, agents, hand-over folders, inputs and generated outputs.

nodes.title: map.json
nodes.detail: Plain JSON you can edit. Every box remembers the files it came from, which is how drift is detected.

nodes.title: render_map.py
nodes.detail: Rejects broken maps with a list of problems, then writes one self-contained HTML file.

nodes.title: board.py
nodes.detail: Serves your maps on 127.0.0.1 and colours boxes from session logs, files, timers and git.

nodes.title: You
nodes.detail: Tidy the draft by hand: titles, zones, positions.

nodes.title: Coding agent
nodes.detail: With SKILL.md an agent runs discover.py, then names things, groups zones and writes the descriptions.

nodes.title: map.html
nodes.detail: Open in any browser, phone included. Share it, attach it to a PR, put a screenshot in your README.

nodes.title: Live board
nodes.detail: Boxes glow while an agent works; an activity feed and today's estimated cost.

nodes.title: Drift warnings
nodes.detail: New scripts or workflows that are not on the map, and boxes whose files are gone.
